stem:
This graphic organizer is being used to classify triangles based on their angle measures or side lengths.

Which list shows all of the ways this triangle could be classified?
visual_elements: Table with header 'Triangles' with two subcolumns: 'Angle Measure Classification' listing Acute, Right, Obtuse and 'Side Length Classification' listing Isosceles, Equilateral, Scalene
Triangle with all sides labeled 8 cm
